features: 🎶AUTO ON & CONNECT: The Go Pop+ True Wireless earbuds turn on and connect to each other automatically. Just take them out of their USB charging case for seamless, hassle-free connection. Then just connect the ear buds to your phone. 🤏 SMALLER FIT EARBUDS: Smaller than a credit card, the Go Pop+ buds case fits in your pocket and the Bluetooth earbuds are our smallest yet; 15% smaller and 40% lighter with the small case, than the Go Air wireless earphones. Ideal for the gym, sport or to carry while running. Try the three tip sizes to get a snug in ear headphones fit and creating a perfect seal for crystal clear sound Hybrid ANC Up To 48 dB + Transparency Mode: Environmental and Adaptive ANC for better focus, with quick awareness mode when needed

Up To 55 Hours Playback (AAC): Up to 55 hours with case and 13.5 hours with buds only (ANC off); up to 32 hours with case and 7.5 hours buds only (ANC on / Transparency) 🔋BATTERY LIFE: Listen for the long battery life with your wireless earphones; stay for the comfort. Go Pop+ features 9+ hours of playtime in each earbud and 26+ extra hours from the charging case. That’s 35+ hours of playtime with your bluetooth earphones
Bluetooth 5.4 + Dual Connection: Stable connectivity and easy switching across two connected devices
Fast Charge Support: 10 min charge gives up to 4 hours (buds only) and 7.5 hours (with case) with ANC off; with ANC on up to 2.4 hours (buds) and 4 hours (with case)
description: Experience powerful and seamless audio with these Wireless Earbuds Bluetooth 5.3 TWS Earphones designed for everyday convenience and performance. Featuring advanced Bluetooth 5.3 technology, these earbuds ensure fast pairing, stable connectivity, and low latency for uninterrupted music, calls, and gaming. The premium sound quality delivers clear audio with rich bass for an immersive listening experience. Equipped with full touch control, you can easily manage music playback, answer or reject calls, and activate voice assistants with a simple tap. The built-in high-definition microphone provides clear voice quality for hands-free calling, online meetings, and voice chats. Designed with a lightweight and ergonomic fit, these earbuds offer all-day comfort for work, travel, workouts, and daily use. The included Type-C charging case supports quick and convenient charging, keeping your earbuds powered throughout the day while ensuring reliable performance with most Android and iOS devices.
